user.title: Connect to SpeisePlan
user.description: Enter the address of your SpeisePlan server. As a Home Assistant add-on it is only reachable at its internal hostname, which looks like 49e94de4-speiseplan and is printed in the add-on log; the instance ID is shown on SpeisePlan's Settings page (/settings).

reconfigure.title: Change SpeisePlan connection
reconfigure.description: Update where SpeisePlan is reachable. It must be the same instance, otherwise add it as a new entry.

error.unsupported_version: This SpeisePlan is too old — it has no API. Update it to a version that serves /api/v1.

abort.wrong_instance: Those details belong to a different SpeisePlan instance
